g.text: Roof discone above 240 MHz: real stations on top of the analyzer's own FM harmonics

text.style: fill: #52514e; font: 9.5px 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: HIGH input, median of three sweeps. FM broadcast at up to −26 dBm overdrives the unfiltered input, which then makes FM ×3…×9 humps (labelled at the

text.style: fill: #52514e; font: 9.5px 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: bottom). Carriers above the humps are real; the floor between them is not the roof's.
